Subject: Datadog renewal — initial quote and retention add-on options

Hi Neha / David,

Thanks for the details on volumes. I attached an initial quote for Q4 renewal and the retention add-on options we discussed. Key callouts:
- Standard plan renewal: no change in unit pricing; 12-month term.
- Logs tiering: warm storage (30 days) + cold retention (90/365 options) as add-ons.
- 365-day cold option adds ~42% to the total line-item for logs.

If you can share your target spend and preferred retention bands (30/90/365), I can carve a proposal that includes a staged discount and a committed usage pilot for high-ingest services.

Attachments: Datadog_quote_Q4_2026.pdf

Best,

Subject: Re: Datadog renewal — initial quote and retention add-on options

Thanks Olivia — attaching our internal retention schedule and a short note on target spend.

High level asks from Redwood:
- We need a 12-month deal with an option to extend to 24 months if the committed usage tier hits 80% in Q1.
- Target is to reduce monthly observable spend by ~18% relative to current run-rate through a combination of: (a) log tiering to colder storage for bulk of events, (b) sampling/ingest filters for debug-only sources, and (c) a commitment discount on high-ingest services.
- Data residency/legal: any cold-export to S3 must support cross-account encryption and audit logs; Laura, please confirm legal constraints in the attachment.

Attachments: log-retention-schedule.xlsx

Can you also loop in Grafana and Sentry contacts so we can coordinate overlapping renewal windows? We want a single, cohesive plan before procurement executes.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Head of Procurement — Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai

From: Tom Reyes <t.reyes@grafana.com>
To: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 11:45:00 -0800
Subject: Grafana Cloud — options for metrics + logs tiering

Hi Neha — looping in per your note. We typically recommend keeping metrics on Grafana Cloud and offloading logs to a cold tier (object storage) after 14–30 days for most SaaS customers. Options we can propose:
- Managed Loki with short retention + long-term archive to customer S3 (cross-account) — lower monthly cost but higher egress for retrieval.
- Hosted Loki long-retention (365d) as a premium bundle.

I'll run a quick cost delta vs Datadog cold-export in a matrix and share a spreadsheet. Also, we can provide a bundled discount if both metrics and logs are purchased through Grafana Cloud for the same account.

Best,
Tom Reyes
Partner Sales — Grafana Labs

From: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, david_kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>, stephanie_nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Log tiering savings plan & vendor renewal coordination

All — quick legal/security pass on cross-account retention/export:
- Approved: cross-account S3 exports with customer-managed KMS, provided we maintain object-level audit logs for 2 years.
- Pending: a clarification on cold storage access SLAs. Procurement needs a statement of access and an export+delete flow for legal hold.

Notes: Stephanie, can the observability team produce a short runbook for retrieval times (expected latencies) and a sample query cost estimate for weekly restores from cold? That input is what procurement will use to compare vendor TCO.

Laura Bennett
Head of Legal — Redwood Inference

Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 16:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Log tiering savings plan & vendor renewal coordination

Thanks everyone — next steps and asks consolidated below. Please reply by EOD Tuesday 2026-12-01 with your confirmation or an updated proposal:

1) Datadog (Olivia): provide a revised quote that: (a) includes a staged discount schedule tied to Q1 committed utilization, (b) separates warm vs cold log costs line-itemized, and (c) confirms cross-account S3 export architecture and audit logging. Attach preferred DocuSign link for a 12-month with a 12-month extension option.
2) Grafana (Tom): share the cost comparison matrix and the bundled discount offer if Redwood shifts metrics to Grafana and cold-archives logs to S3. Include expected restore latency for archived logs.
3) Sentry Renewals: confirm whether error-volume tiers can be re-bucketed to reduce billing (we have many low-value noise events) and share a simple delta quote for a 12-month term.
4) Internal (David / Stephanie): provide retrieval latency + weekly restore cost estimates and a proposed sampling policy for debug sources.
5) Legal (Laura): finalize the export+delete flow language procurement will use in the SOW.

I'll coordinate a short review call Thursday 12/3 — scheduling invite to follow.

Attachments referenced: Datadog_quote_Q4_2026.pdf, grafana_cloud_pricing_matrix.xlsx, log-retention-schedule.xlsx
